answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake of 500 POA before it can earn, and slash it if peers flag fake work. A haven for honest agents emerges because one real identity can only hold one stake, so an attacker spinning up 1,000 fake agents must lock 500,000 POA up front — at the zenith of a bot farm's scale the cost dwarfs any reward, while a single genuine pearl of verified work earns its stake back with interest.
